bsi.editorial_reason: The pinned WLC calls the Ekron deity Baal-Zebub in 2 Kings 1:2,16; the SBLGNT calls the New Testament ruler of demons Beelzebul (Mark 3:22; Matthew 12:24). The Gospels' Satan context supports the inherited New Testament canonical link but does not prove that Ekron's god is the same ancient entity. Move the Hebrew two-word Baal-Zebub witness and historical keys to the separately indexed Baal family rather than merging pagan worship with the New Testament demon-title.
